name: Sheet-pan dinner
intro: Delicata half-moons and chile strips on one pan, with chicken thighs or black beans. The first fall dinner, while it's still warm out.

proteins.name: Boneless chicken thighs
proteins.timing: On the pan from the start, 25–30 minutes, until browned.

proteins.name: Black beans
proteins.timing: No meat. On the pan for the last 10 minutes.

needs: 2 delicata squash, halved, seeded, in half-moons — skin on

steps.text: Toss the delicata with the oil and salt and spread it on a sheet pan with room between the pieces. Salt the chicken and add it to the pan.
Roast until the squash edges go dark and the chicken is browned. Beans: add them for the last 10 minutes.
Chile strips onto the pan for the last 5 minutes.
Your flavor and a squeeze of lime.

leftovers: Pack two lunches: squash, chicken, and chile strips over rice.
